name: architecture-update
purpose: Insert or append scoped architecture decisions, preserving existing text and refreshing shadow section links.
pre_prompt: Read the current architecture index and section. Declare architecture.md in the frozen task. Supply current source SHA256; use concrete file links and brief prose. Never replace the whole document.
post_prompt: Verify the fresh receipt and updated section IDs. The edit invalidates prior tests; run frozen tests and the completion gate. If stale or out of scope, reload evidence and replan.
